gradientglass.config.transition_width.de: Width in blocks of the transition on each side of the border between stained glass and connected clear glass.
gradientglass.config.blur.description: Mixes each glass block's color with the glass within one block, so color changes spread wider. When off, colors only blend between adjacent blocks.
gradientglass.config.pattern_layers.desc: Where stained glass with different patterns meets, how many other textures are laid over each face near the border so the patterns blend. 0 turns it off. Each layer adds about one more full set of subdivided faces in the transition, most where several colors meet; vanilla stained glass shares one pattern and is unaffected.
Pieces per direction a full block face is split into where its color varies. Higher is smoother but adds faces.
gradientglass.config.pane_rows.descripti: Pieces a pane is split into along its height where its color varies.
gradientglass.config.pane_segments.descr: Pieces each pane arm is split into along its length where its color varies.
gradientglass.config.beacon_gradient.des: Where a beacon beam changes color, it fades from the color below over one block.
gradientglass.config.beacon_dye.descript: Clear glass and panes inside a dyed beacon beam take the beam's color.
gradientglass.config.weak_channel.descri: A stained texture channel whose brightest value is below this fraction of the brightest channel uses the luminance pattern instead, so tinting it toward other colors shows no noise. Reloads resources when changed.
gradientglass.config.visible_alpha.descr: Pixels below this alpha are ignored when finding each channel's brightest value in stained textures. Reloads resources when changed.
